intent: Verify whether the Osram Night Breaker Night 1EE-770 Automotive Charger and Bulb catalogue variant carries the claimed extra property (vehicle type van) on top of its base attributes, and answer YES/NO with the checked SKU.
success_criteria: Located the base catalogue variant for Osram 1EE-770 Automotive Charger and Bulb (returns product_sku + record_path).

Enumerated all product_variant_properties rows for that SKU to confirm base attrs (product type jump starter, voltage 12, current 6, vehicle type universal) and to test for the extra 'vehicle_type=van' claim.
Answer contains a <YES> or <NO> token and names the checked SKU.
refs cite the exact matched product record_path, not a parent directory.

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name, pv.brand, pv.series, pv.model, pp.property_key, pp.property_value_text FROM product_variants pv LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties pp ON pp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.model = :model AND pv.product_name LIKE :name_pattern ORDER BY pv.product_sku, pp.property_key;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.

answer_template.message: <NO> Base catalogue item exists: {variant_props.product_name} (SKU {variant_props.product_sku}, record {variant_props.record_path}) with product type jump starter, voltage 12 V, current 6 A, vehicle type universal. The extra support-note claim 'vehicle type van' is NOT present on this variant's properties — checked SKU {variant_props.product_sku}.
